messages:
marta: Heads-up team 11:40 UTC7: we rolled a quantization profile change in eu-west canary and are seeing a small class of incorrect tokenization/hallucination traces. Pausing rollout and drafting comms.

deploybot: Rollout paused by operator at 11:42 UTC. Canary traffic set to 0%. Job: runtime-eu-quant-2026-06-21. Auto-rollback not triggered (manual pause). Rollout state: paused.

sam: Thanks. We need a short statuspage + an internal triage blurb for support. Keep public copy minimal, internal has rollback criteria.

nina: Public status draft suggestion: "Investigation: We are investigating a limited issue affecting some EU inference requests after a runtime update. Some customers may see incorrect outputs for a subset of queries. We have paused the rollout and are rolling traffic back to the previous stable variant. We will post updates here: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2912345678"

ops_sre: Internal triage checklist: 1) collect sample request IDs and outputs 2) snapshot failing canary hosts and core dumps 3) re-pin traffic to redwood-v2-stable-2026-06 4) run synthetic smoke across long prompts and binary edgecases 5) monitor 5xx and mismatch rate. Rollback triggers (internal): - Any customer P1 reports of corrupted outputs - Mismatch rate >0.2% sustained 5m - Evidence of tokenization errors from decode logs

emily: Customer email snippet (short):

emily: Subject: Investigating issue with EU inference runtime (Jun 21)

emily: Body: "We are investigating a limited issue affecting some EU inference requests after a planned runtime change. We paused the rollout and reverted affected traffic to the previous stable runtime. If you depend on pinned versions, contact support for details. We will post updates at: https://status.redwood.ai/"

julia: Add Dedicated note for the status: "Dedicated and private pools are not changed unless explicitly scheduled; if you see unexpected behavior and you have a reserved pool, open a support ticket and we'll prioritize."

sam: Internal rollback snippet for playbook: ```Action: 1) Pause rollout (done) 2) Re-pin EU traffic to redwood-v2-stable-2026-05 3) Start full canary rollback job to stable image 4) Notify affected customers via status + targeted emails 5) If >5% traffic affected, open incident channel and escalate to SRE/Model leads```

nina: Proposed short statuspage update (ready to publish): "Update 11:50 UTC: Rollout paused and traffic reverted to stable runtime. We're investigating a small subset of requests that may have incorrect outputs. No widespread impact observed. We'll post another update within 60 minutes or earlier if new info is available."

support-bot: Reminder: publish status update now and queue targeted email to affected customers list (if list non-empty).

emily: Publishing statuspage and queuing email to affected accounts. Email will include support contact and link to incident.

ops_sre: Early triage: tokenization mismatch traced to quantization table differences when decoding certain multibyte sequences. Captured sample IDs and pushed to model team. Will attempt repro on stable node.

marta: Good. Once model team confirms root cause, we can decide to either rework quant table or perform a full rollback. For now keep status minimal and avoid technical jargon in public copy.

sam: Support FAQ quick answers: "Will my dedicated pool be affected?" -> "Not unless we scheduled it. Contact your account rep." "Will pinned models be preserved?" -> "We re-pinned traffic to the previous stable variant during the pause."

julia: :thumbsup: on the public copy.

emily: Statuspage posted: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2912345678 11:52 UTC7. Targeted emails queued.

support-bot: Incident stub created and assigned to support-duty. Next update expected by 12:30 UTC.

ops_sre: Model team confirmed quantization regression repro on canary. Rework underway. If fixETA >90m we should prepare rollback job to clear the quant change entirely.

marta: Agreed. Keep this thread for live updates. We'll prepare both options: patch or full rollback. Notify CS for any enterprise customers on the affected list.

deploybot: Canary rollback job prepared (ready to trigger) if requested by SRE.

emily: Sending targeted note to affected enterprise customers with incident link and support contact.

sam: Noting for postmortem: review release gating and add a decode regression test to smoke suite.

marta: Closing for now until we have a patch ETA. Reopen thread with updates.
